notes.title: Dead's Prison Watcher Released Update V1.1
notes.content:
Greetings gentlemans and gentlewomans!

Finally released V1.1 update with following changes below:

> The prisoner now is released at 2 minutes.

> General game duration reduced from 26 to 18 minutes only, meaning that the last release innocent can now be released at 18 minutes.

> All other gamemodes are also quicker, already starting at 2 minutes.

> The hallucinations now can appear... without any guard dead.

> A small change on guard's function choose window, adding some text to specify what type of guard you can select.

> Some text fixes and images updates on instructions panel.

That is all, make sure to enjoy this new changes!

I hope that you have a good week!

My regards, Twisted Gentleman.
